# Research & Data Science Portfolio

This page brings together selected research and data science projects, combining substantive social science questions with computational and quantitative methods.

My work includes statistical modeling, geospatial analysis, and reproducible research using Python and R.

[CONFLICT RESEARCH]{.project-category}

### [Patterns of Armed-Conflict Violence in Colombia](projects/colombia-violence-eda.html)

An exploratory analysis of recorded conflict-related violence between 2018 and 2024, examining temporal trends, geographic distributions, violence categories, and associated armed groups.

**Methods:** Exploratory Data Analysis · Python · Data Visualization

[Explore Project →](projects/colombia-violence-eda.html)

[GEOSPATIAL & CLIMATE ANALYSIS]{.project-category}

### [Urban Heat Islands and Spatial Vulnerability in Santiago](projects/santiago-urban-heat.html)

A geospatial analysis of land surface temperatures and the distribution of older residents in Greater Santiago, using satellite imagery and spatial statistics.

**Methods:** Python · GIS · Moran's I · LISA

[Explore Project →](projects/santiago-urban-heat.html)

## Tools and Methods

- **Programming:** Python, R
- **Quantitative analysis:** Statistical modeling, dimensionality reduction, clustering
- **Comparative methods:** Qualitative Comparative Analysis (QCA)
- **Geospatial methods:** Spatial data analysis and visualization
- **Reproducible research:** Jupyter Notebooks, Google Colab, GitHub
